text: Stronger court rejects increasing coordinate smoothing as the visual remedy. At step 0.1, 5 and 10 iterations reduce independent coordinate roughness but introduce 1 and 4 reversed sliver faces before producing a compelling visual difference. Exact mesh4s 491bea6 analytic/reference CoordinateSmoothingSuite passes 9/9 on JVM and 9/9 on Scala.js; this is the documented limitation of unconstrained uniform Laplacian, not current evidence of a kernel defect. Keep public recipes at 1-2 and original default. Normals-only 10x0.5 is visibly stronger without geometry motion but looks over-smoothed; treat it as direction-finding only.
